failed_tests.reason: Duplicate placeLimitOrder() function definition. Function at line 20542 (requires wallet) overrides function at line 17752 (no wallet check). Shows 'Connect wallet first' toast instead of opening modal.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Limit Orders page shows 'Connect wallet first' instead of opening TX confirm modal
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Duplicate function definition - placeLimitOrder() is defined twice in the codebase. Line 17752 has the correct implementation for the dedicated Limit Orders page (no wallet check), but line 20542 has another implementation for the swap page's limit order tab (requires wallet). JavaScript uses the last definition, so the wallet-requiring version is always used.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_suggestion: Rename the function at line 20542 to placeLimitOrderSwap() and update the onclick handler on the swap page's limit order button to call the renamed function
